text: The ChatGPT web interface has changed and same users are reporting that is needed to click "Force completion" when the answer in completed.
See #1011 for more information.
The ChatGPT web interface has changed and same users are reporting errors when attempting to use ThunderAI.
See #924 for more information.
Version 5.0.3 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT web interface has changed and consistently returns an error when attempting to use ThunderAI.
This appears to be an issue with how Thunderbird 140.* loads webpages, and there is no current workaround.
The solution is to update to the monthly version 149.* or wait for the next ESR release scheduled for the beginning of July 2026.
See #776 for more information.
The ChatGPT Web Interface has been changed and ThunderAI under some circumstances is not able to import the selected text.
See #646 for more information.
Version 3.8.4 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT Web Interface has been changed and ThunderAI is not getting any more the job completion, forcing the user to click on the "Force completion" link.
See #607 for more information.
Version 3.7.9 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT Web Interface has been changed and the input field to write more messages after the first prompt is sent, is no more visibile.
See #556 for more information.
Version 3.7.6 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT Web Interface is again not correctly dececting when the reponse is completed.
You could click the "force completion" button to get the full response.
Version 3.5.4 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT Web Interface is not correctly dececting when the reponse is completed.
You could click the "force completion" button to get the full response.
Version 3.5.3 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT Web Interface is not working with a free account [see #408].
Version 3.5.2 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT web interface sometimes displays the audio button, preventing the automatic prompt from being sent [see #188], and occasionally pushes the input field too far down [see #189].
Version 2.3.3 fixes the issues.
The ChatGPT web interface is using a new feature that is not compatible with Firefox 115, which causes the ChatGPT Web Interface to stop working in Thunderbird 115.
See #139.
Version 2.1.5 fixes the issue.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents again the addon from working.
See #133.
From version 2.1.4 the issue has been fixed, update the addon directly from Thunderbird.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents the addon from working.
From version 2.1.2 the issue has been fixed, update the addon directly from Thunderbird.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents the addon from sending automatically the prompt.
Version 2.0.7 fixes the issue.
Meanwhile just press the button to send the prompt.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents the addon from correctly importing the text when replying or substituting.
Version 2.0.2 fixes the issue.
Starting from version 2.0.2, to use a response in a reply, the user must select the text.
A single click should suffice, but it is also possible to manually select the desired text.
See #103.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents the addon from correctly importing the text when replying or substituting, unless the "Keep formatting" option is used.
Version 1.2.1 fixes the issue. See #87.
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents to send the prompt. You have to click the send button.
The imported text has a ChatGPT string in front of it that you have to remove manually.
From version 1.0.8 onwards, the issues are fixed (#57 and #60).
A change in the ChatGPT web interface prevents the button to use the answer automatically from appearing.
Version 1.0.6 fixes the issue (#43).
If using ChatGPT-4 model, maintain the ChatGPT window width to 700.
With a larger width, it may not function properly.
See issue #38.
